data.title: Refusal of permit for a New Year's beach bonfire
data.summary: Amt Musterschlei's Ordnungsamt has refused Tjark Beispielholm's application for a traditional New Year's bonfire on the beach near Knickweg, because the site lies within the "Musterschlei-Ufer" landscape protection area and would disturb nesting birds in the adjacent reeds. The letter offers participation in the municipality's communal bonfire at the harbour square instead, and notes an objection (Widerspruch) may be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The local authority (Ordnungsamt) has turned down your request to light a bonfire on the beach because the area is protected for nature conservation reasons. You are invited to join the official communal bonfire at the harbour instead. If you disagree with this decision, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Amt Musterschlei, and the app will show you the deadline. If you do nothing by then, the refusal stands. No payment or further action is otherwise required.
